meta.description: NVDA split-adjusted monthly closing prices and event reactions, plus comparators.
meta.priceSource: Yahoo Finance chart API (daily closes, split-adjusted; monthly points are the last trading session of each calendar month)
caveats: Monthly series covers Jan-2015 through Jun-2026 = 138 points per ticker. July 2026 is excluded because the month is incomplete.

Yahoo's daily array returned a null close for 2026-07-24; the $206.84 figure used for the current market cap comes from meta.regularMarketPrice with regularMarketTime 2026-07-24 16:00 ET. It is NOT used in the monthly series.

For 2022-11-30, 2023-05-30 and 2025-01-27 the news broke intraday, so `pctMoveOnDate` (vs the prior close) is the meaningful reaction, not `pctMove`. The `reactionSession` and `reactionPct` fields disambiguate this for every event.
NVIDIA releases quarterly results after the closing bell, so for earnings entries the next trading session is the reaction day and `pctMove` is the reaction.
NVIDIA also filed an Item 2.02 8-K on 2022-08-08 (a preliminary Q2 FY2023 revenue warning, issued pre-market). It is excluded from the quarterly list because it was not a scheduled quarterly report.
Market-cap milestones are dated by FIRST CLOSE above each threshold. Intraday first touches came earlier for $1T, $2T and $4T and are recorded in each note.
No $6tn milestone has been reached; that entry has a null date.
currentMarketCap.valueUsd is computed (shares x price), not quoted verbatim by a news source, because no approved outlet published an exact figure for 2026-07-24.
The #1 global rank was genuinely contested in July 2026: Apple briefly overtook NVIDIA intraday on 2026-07-17 before NVIDIA closed slightly ahead.

eventReactions.event: NVIDIA Q3 FY2019 earnings - crypto inventory correction, weak guidance
NVIDIA Q1 FY2024 earnings - blowout Q2 revenue guidance (~$11bn)
NVDA first touched $1 trillion market cap intraday (closed ~$990.7bn)
NVIDIA Q1 FY2025 earnings - 10-for-1 split announced
DeepSeek selloff - record one-day market-cap loss of ~$593bn
NVIDIA Q4 FY2026 earnings - FY2026 revenue $215.9bn, +65% y/y
NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 earnings - revenue $81.6bn, +85% y/y

marketCapMilestones.note: First CLOSE above $1tn (7th US company to do so). Intraday $1tn first touched 2023-05-30, but that session closed at ~$990.7bn; CNBC put the $1tn threshold at $404.86/share. NVDA closed 2023-06-13 at $410.20 pre-split ($41.02 split-adjusted).
First close above $2tn, at $2.06tn; 3rd most valuable US company at the time. Intraday $2tn first touched 2024-02-23.
Closed at $3.012tn, overtaking Apple to become the world's 2nd most valuable company. Reuters reports the close as $1,224.40 (pre 10-for-1 split).
First company ever to close above $4tn, at $4.004tn; shares +0.75% to $164.10. Intraday $4tn first touched 2025-07-09 (closed ~$3.97tn).
First company ever to reach $5tn, closing at $207.04 for ~$5.03tn, roughly three months after $4tn.

currentMarketCap.rank: #1 globally, but effectively tied with Apple - the two swapped the top spot repeatedly during July 2026. NVIDIA has held #1 since June 2025 (when it passed Microsoft); Alphabet is 3rd at roughly $4.2tn.
currentMarketCap.method: Derived: 24.2bn shares outstanding (NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 10-Q cover page, as of 2026-05-15) x $206.84 close on 2026-07-24. NVIDIA rounds the cover-page share count to 3 significant figures, so this is precise to roughly +/- $0.02tn.
